name: comote
description: GugleComote local remote companion for Codex Desktop.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:server && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-desktop-dev.mjs && npm run sidecar:build && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:server && npm run desktop:icons && npm run sidecar:build:mac && node scripts/install-prod-deps.mjs && tauri build --bundles app --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/sign-macos-app.mjs && node scripts/create-mac-dmg.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:server && npm run desktop:icons && npm run sidecar:build:win && node scripts/install-prod-deps.mjs && tauri build --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/collect-tauri-artifacts.mjs win
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && tsx --test test/*.test.ts
